title: Spectral gap for unlabelled Ginibre Interacting Brownian motion
summary: We determine the exact spectral gaps for both the finite-particle and infinite-particle unlabelled Ginibre interacting Brownian motions. In every finite-particle system, the spectral gap is equal to one, whereas for the infinite-particle system it is equal to two. The infinite-particle dynamics therefore has a strictly larger spectral gap than any of its finite-particle counterparts, revealing an enhancement of spectral gaps in the passage from finite to infinite particle systems.
